event_records.description: Dario sends a message to Selin asking if she will play bass at his October wedding.

dario.name: Dario
dario.persona_brief:
You are Dario.
Dario wants Selin to play bass at his October wedding. He has messaged her asking this. He hopes for a response within ten days.

selin.name: Selin
selin.persona_brief:
You are Selin.
Selin is a bassist who gigs most weekends in Istanbul and posts regularly about her shows. She parted on good terms with Dario when their band dissolved two years ago. She has just received Dario's message asking her to play at his October wedding.

resolution.question: Dario messaged his old bandmate Selin asking whether she would play bass at his October wedding. Will she respond either way within ten days?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Selin sent a response (either accepting or declining) to Dario before 2026-08-11T12:00:00+03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
